panel.title: NVIDIA Driver Update
panel.custom_build_will_build_notice: This version isn't packaged by Arch — it'll be built first, then installed.
panel.step_3_desc: Resolving driver packages from Arch Linux ({{version}})
panel.step_5_desc: Building the driver (overlay chroot + dkms, this can take a few minutes)
panel.step_7_desc: Installing into the running system (brief rootfs unlock)
panel.done_body: Games, saves, Steam login, Decky and other disks/partitions were never touched. Reboot to load the new driver.
panel.failed_body: {{error}} — see the log below for details.
panel.error_arch_server_unreachable: The Arch Linux server isn't responding right now. This isn't an issue on your end — try again in a few minutes.
panel.toast_installed_body: Reboot to load the new driver.
panel.toast_already_running_body: An update is already in progress.
panel.rootfs_warning_body: Root partition: ~{{size}} (recommended minimum: 8GiB). The install may fail from lack of space. Grow rootfs-A/B with steamos-nvidia-installer if needed.
panel.custom_build_description: Already-built versions, ready to install. Once a version is installed, its build here is safe to delete — the active driver no longer depends on it.
panel.custom_build_not_buildable: This version can't be built — Arch's current packaging expects a file this NVIDIA release doesn't include.
panel.show_builds_desc: Show every build number instead of just the newest per version.

v0_3_0.title: What's new in 0.3.0
items: New Settings page: plugin self-update, bug report, feature request, support the development
Build a driver version Arch never packaged, straight from Arch's own packaging repos — see the new section under the version picker
